title: 碎膝重击
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：上、左、左、右。左斩后，从右侧以刺击攻击对手面部，然后迅速进行三次攻击，最后以攻击膝盖收尾
second_page: 碎膝重击是最华丽的致命招式，3次攻击，次次命中要害。并且可以重创敌人的膝盖，让他们难以移动

en_us.title: Knee Break
en_us.first_page: Input: Up, Left, Left, Right. After the left cut, thrust into the opponent's face from the right, follow with three quick attacks, and finish on the knee.
en_us.second_page: Knee Break is the showiest of the killing moves: three attacks, each aimed at a weak point. It also cripples the enemy's knee, leaving them struggling to move.
